Hymn 159: Now the Day Is Over
Time Signature: 4/4
Musical Key: E-flat Major
Composer: Joseph Barnby
Lyricist/Text Author: Sabine Baring-Gould
Category: Special Topics

This is hymn number 159 titled "Now the Day Is Over" from the Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints hymnbook. 
It is written in E-flat Major with a 4/4 time signature. 
The music was composed by Joseph Barnby and the lyrics were written by Sabine Baring-Gould.
